order.description: Hilbert curve order (integer between 2 and 16); 0 or omitted lets btrfs-heatmap auto-choose

sort.description: Sorting mode: 'physical' (dev_extent order, default) or 'virtual' (chunk/stripe order)

blockgroup.description: Virtual address (vaddr) of the block group to visualize; 0 or omitted for full filesystem view

verbose.description: Verbosity level (non-negative integer); use -v, -vv etc. by setting 1, 2, etc.

output.description: Output filename, directory, or '-' for stdout; empty string lets btrfs-heatmap auto-choose
